description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a wrapper around the fetch API to facilitate making HTTP requests to a backend API. It includes functions to construct URLs based on environment configurations, perform requests with appropriate headers, handle JSON responses, and normalize errors.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL using the base API URL and the given path, handling potential trailing slashes and relative paths.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the backend API with the specified path and options, handling response parsing, content types, errors, and special cases like HTTP 204 No Content.
